1: # Qwen2.5-VL
2: 
3: ## Abstract (excerpt)
4: 
5: > Note: the source draft begins mid-sentence, so the opening of the abstract is not present and the polished excerpt starts at the first available sentence.
6: 
7: …such as operating computers and mobile devices. The model generalizes strongly across domains without task-specific fine-tuning. Qwen2.5-VL is released in three sizes, covering use cases from edge AI to high-performance computing. The flagship Qwen2.5-VL-72B model matches the performance of state-of-the-art models such as GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and it is particularly strong in document and diagram understanding. The smaller Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-3B models outperform comparable competitors and retain strong capabilities in resource-constrained environments. In addition, Qwen2.5-VL preserves the core linguistic competence of the Qwen2.5 LLM.
8: 
9: Project resources:
10: 
11: - Chat: https://chat.qwenlm.ai
12: - Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/Qwen
13: - ModelScope: https://modelscope.cn/organization/qwen
14: - GitHub: https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen2.5-VL
15: 
16: ## Introduction
17: 
18: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) (OpenAI, 2024; Anthropic, 2024a; Team et al., 2023; Wang et al., 2024f) represent a pivotal breakthrough in artificial intelligence and signal a transformative approach to multimodal understanding and interaction. By integrating visual perception with natural language processing, these models are reshaping how machines interpret and analyze complex information across diverse domains.
19: 
20: Despite these advances, current multimodal large language models resemble the middle layer of a sandwich cookie: competent across many tasks but rarely exceptional. Fine-grained visual perception forms the foundational layer of this structure. In this iteration of Qwen2.5-VL, we therefore focus on fine-grained perception, with two goals: to establish a robust foundation for LVLMs and to create an agentic amplifier for real-world applications. The top layer of this framework is multimodal reasoning, which we strengthen by building on the latest Qwen2.5 LLM and by constructing multimodal QA data.
21: 
22: A range of studies has advanced multimodal large models through architectural design, visual input processing, and data curation. Continuous innovation in architecture is a primary driver of progress in LVLMs. The studies in (Alayrac et al., 2022; Li et al., 2022a; Li et al., 2023b; Liu et al., 2023b; Liu et al., 2023a; Wang et al., 2024i; Zhang et al., 2024b; Wang et al., 2023) have incrementally shaped the current paradigm, which typically consists of a visual encoder, a cross-modal projector, and a large language model (LLM). Fine-grained perception models have emerged as another crucial area. Models such as (Xiao et al., 2023; Liu et al., 2023c; Ren et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2024a; Zhang et al., 2024d; Peng et al., 2023; Deitke et al., 2024) have pushed the boundaries of detailed visual understanding. The architectures of Omni systems (Li et al., 2024g; Li et al., 2025b; Ye et al., 2024) and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models (Riquelme et al., 2021; Lee et al., 2024; Li et al., 2024h; Li et al., 2024c; Wu et al., 2024b) also inform the future evolution of LVLMs. Improvements in visual encoders (Chen et al., 2023; Liu et al., 2024b; Liang et al., 2025) and in resolution scaling (Li et al., 2023c; Ye et al., 2023; Li et al., 2023a) have improved the quality of practical visual understanding. Curating data across more diverse scenarios and at higher quality is also essential for training advanced LVLMs, and the efforts in (Guo et al., 2024; Chen et al., 2024d; Liu et al., 2024a; Chen et al., 2024a; Tong et al., 2024; Li et al., 2024a) are valuable contributions to this endeavor.
23: 
24: Despite this progress, vision-language models still face several bottlenecks, including computational complexity, limited contextual understanding, poor fine-grained visual perception, and inconsistent performance across sequence lengths. In this report, we introduce Qwen2.5-VL, which continues the open-source philosophy of the Qwen series and achieves, and in places surpasses, top-tier closed-source models on various benchmarks. Our contributions are fourfold. First, we implement window attention in the visual encoder to improve inference efficiency. Second, we introduce dynamic FPS sampling, which extends dynamic resolution to the temporal dimension and enables comprehensive video understanding across sampling rates. Third, we upgrade the Multimodal Rotary Position Embedding (MRoPE) in the temporal domain by aligning it to absolute time, facilitating more sophisticated temporal sequence learning. Fourth, we curate high-quality data for both pre-training and supervised fine-tuning, scaling the pre-training corpus from 1.2 trillion to 4.1 trillion tokens.
25: 
26: The key capabilities of Qwen2.5-VL are as follows:
27: 
28: - **Powerful document parsing.** Qwen2.5-VL extends text recognition to omni-document parsing and handles multi-scene, multilingual, and built-in documents, including handwriting, tables, charts, chemical formulas, and music sheets.
29: - **Precise object grounding across formats.** Qwen2.5-VL improves the accuracy of detecting, pointing to, and counting objects, and it supports absolute-coordinate and JSON formats for advanced spatial reasoning.
30: - **Ultra-long video understanding and fine-grained video grounding.** The model extends native dynamic resolution to the temporal dimension, so it can understand videos lasting hours while extracting event segments of only seconds.
31: - **Enhanced agent functionality on computers and mobile devices.** Advanced grounding, reasoning, and decision-making give the model stronger agent behavior on smartphones and computers.
32: 
33: ## Approach
34: 
35: This section first outlines the architectural updates of the Qwen2.5-VL series and then gives an overview of the data and training details.
36: 
37: **Figure 1. The Qwen2.5-VL framework.** A vision encoder and a language model decoder process multimodal inputs, including images and videos. The vision encoder handles inputs at native resolution and supports dynamic FPS sampling: images of varying sizes and video frames at different FPS rates are mapped dynamically to token sequences of varying lengths. MRoPE aligns time IDs with absolute time along the temporal dimension, which helps the model capture temporal dynamics such as the pace of events and precise moment localization. The processed visual data are then fed into the Qwen2.5 LM decoder.
38: 
39: We re-engineered the Vision Transformer (ViT) architecture with feed-forward network (FFN) layers that use SwiGLU activation, RMSNorm normalization, and window attention, which improves performance and efficiency.
40:

The architectures of Omni systems (Li et al., 2024g; Li et al., 2025b; Ye et al., 2024) and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models (Riquelme et al., 2021; Lee et al., 2024; Li et al., 2024h; Li et al., 2024c; Wu et al., 2024b) also inform the future evolution of LVLMs. Improvements in visual encoders (Chen et al., 2023; Liu et al., 2024b; Liang et al., 2025) and in resolution scaling (Li et al., 2023c; Ye et al., 2023; Li et al., 2023a) have improved the quality of practical visual understanding. Curating data across more diverse scenarios and at higher quality is also essential for training advanced LVLMs, and the efforts in (Guo et al., 2024; Chen et al., 2024d; Liu et al., 2024a; Chen et al., 2024a; Tong et al., 2024; Li et al., 2024a) are valuable contributions to this endeavor.

Despite this progress, vision-language models still face several bottlenecks, including computational complexity, limited contextual understanding, poor fine-grained visual perception, and inconsistent performance across sequence lengths. In this report, we introduce Qwen2.5-VL, which continues the open-source philosophy of the Qwen series and achieves, and in places surpasses, top-tier closed-source models on various benchmarks. Our contributions are fourfold. First, we implement window attention in the visual encoder to improve inference efficiency. Second, we introduce dynamic FPS sampling, which extends dynamic resolution to the temporal dimension and enables comprehensive video understanding across sampling rates. Third, we upgrade the Multimodal Rotary Position Embedding (MRoPE) in the temporal domain by aligning it to absolute time, facilitating more sophisticated temporal sequence learning. Fourth, we curate high-quality data for both pre-training and supervised fine-tuning, scaling the pre-training corpus from 1.2 trillion to 4.1 trillion tokens.
The key capabilities of Qwen2.5-VL are as follows:

- **Powerful document parsing.** Qwen2.5-VL extends text recognition to omni-document parsing and handles multi-scene, multilingual, and built-in documents, including handwriting, tables, charts, chemical formulas, and music sheets.

- **Precise object grounding across formats.** Qwen2.5-VL improves the accuracy of detecting, pointing to, and counting objects, and it supports absolute-coordinate and JSON formats for advanced spatial reasoning.

- **Ultra-long video understanding and fine-grained video grounding.** The model extends native dynamic resolution to the temporal dimension, so it can understand videos lasting hours while extracting event segments of only seconds.
- **Enhanced agent functionality on computers and mobile devices.** Advanced grounding, reasoning, and decision-making give the model stronger agent behavior on smartphones and computers.
This section first outlines the architectural updates of the Qwen2.5-VL series and then gives an overview of the data and training details.

**Figure 1. The Qwen2.5-VL framework.** A vision encoder and a language model decoder process multimodal inputs, including images and videos. The vision encoder handles inputs at native resolution and supports dynamic FPS sampling: images of varying sizes and video frames at different FPS rates are mapped dynamically to token sequences of varying lengths. MRoPE aligns time IDs with absolute time along the temporal dimension, which helps the model capture temporal dynamics such as the pace of events and precise moment localization. The processed visual data are then fed into the Qwen2.5 LM decoder.

We re-engineered the Vision Transformer (ViT) architecture with feed-forward network (FFN) layers that use SwiGLU activation, RMSNorm normalization, and window attention, which improves performance and efficiency.

35: ## 三、各篇局限详述（逐篇展开）
36: 
37: **A. GPT-4o System Card——评测代理失真、真实鲁棒性与长尾风险未量化。** 其局限首先出在评测工具上：语音能力主要借 TTS 把文本基准转成音频来测，而这一转换对公式、代码、依赖空白与符号排版的输入天然不适用，合成语音也无法代表真实对话中的韵律、情绪、背景噪声与串话，故测得的"能力"与"安全"都可能偏离真实使用分布，作者亦承认错误可能来自 TTS 而非模型。其次是鲁棒性缺口：低质量音频、回声、音频扰动以及生成过程中的打断都会削弱安全表现，模型仍可被诱导复述虚假信息与阴谋论。第三是公平与语言覆盖：非英语场景存在过度拒答，输出可能带非母语口音，五种非洲语言虽缩小了与英语的差距但差距仍在。第四是长尾风险刻画不足：版权、拟人化与情感依赖等社会影响多为定性讨论，缺乏长期、多样化人群的实证；医学评测只测静态知识、不测真实临床工作流，且多项基准趋于饱和、区分度下降。概括为"评测代理失真 + 真实场景鲁棒性不足 + 长尾社会风险未量化"。
38: 
39: **B. Qwen2.5-VL——多模态对齐、数据/语言偏置与真实基准缺位。** 报告未设独立局限章节，短板需从方法与实验反推。首先，多模态对齐仍是核心难题：作者明确指出中间推理步骤可能忽略或误读视觉线索，CoT 在跨模态任务上的可靠验证尚不成熟。其次，数据与语言偏置明显：SFT 数据以中英文为主，多语言 OCR 虽扩展语种但整体覆盖有限；训练大量依赖合成与自建数据（约 100 万合成图表、600 万表格），存在合成分布偏差与真实长尾场景泛化不足的风险。第三，评测以英文基准为主，MMMU、DocVQA、OCRBench 等虽亮眼，但对真实业务文档、噪声图像、低资源语言与对抗样本的鲁棒性验证不足，难以排除基准与训练数据重叠（污染）带来的高估。第四，效率与成本：72B 模型训练与推理开销大，窗口注意力虽降低视觉端计算，但长视频（数百帧、逾 2 万 token）仍受上下文与算力约束。概括为"对齐可靠性 + 数据/语言偏置 + 真实基准缺位 + 成本约束"。
40: 
41: **C. DeepSeek-V3——能力偏科、系统工程脆弱与复现门槛高。** 该文本为节选（缺第 5–6 节），完整局限未系统给出，需结合摘要与可见结果审慎归纳。其一，能力上仍有明确差距：英语事实知识（SimpleQA）落后 GPT-4o 与 Claude，工程类/软件任务略低于 Claude-3.5，说明优势集中于数学、代码与中文事实性，通用知识与复杂工程仍是短板。其二，效率优势伴随工程脆弱性：MoE 路由、FP8 混合精度与跨节点 all-to-all 通信都是强耦合的系统工程，依赖专用 H800 集群与大量前期架构/数据研究（论文强调 557.6 万美元仅含"官方训练"，不含前期试错成本），可移植性与复现门槛高。其三，训练稳定性结论基于单次大规模运行，"无 loss spike、无回滚"的可推广性仍需更多独立复现验证。其四，数据侧对合成数据与污染的影响缺少量化评估，14.8T 语料的构成与清洗透明度有限。概括为"能力偏科 + 系统工程脆弱 + 复现门槛高 + 数据治理不透明"。
42: 
43: **D. DeepSeek-R1——能力短板、奖励依赖与安全可被削弱。** 其局限在文中列得最明确。能力层面：结构化输出与工具调用偏弱（不能用搜索、计算器等外部工具）；token 效率不足，简单题存在过度思考；存在语言混合，主要优化中英文、其他语言可能用英语推理；对提示敏感，few-shot 反而降分；软件工程任务因评测耗时、RL 难以大规模展开而提升有限。方法层面更根本：纯 RL 高度依赖可靠奖励，其成功建立在数学、代码等可规则验证的任务上；对写作等不可验证任务，模型奖励易被"奖励黑客"利用，如何为复杂任务构建稳健奖励模型仍是开放难题，这也是纯 RL 难以推广的根本瓶颈。安全层面：总体安全为中等（约与 GPT-4o 相当），可被越狱攻击，也可被进一步微调破坏原有安全对齐。概括为"能力短板 + 奖励依赖 + 安全可被削弱"。
44: 
45: ## 四、共同模式：哪些局限是跨论文复现的
46:

## 三、各篇局限详述（逐篇展开）

**A. GPT-4o System Card——评测代理失真、真实鲁棒性与长尾风险未量化。** 其局限首先出在评测工具上：语音能力主要借 TTS 把文本基准转成音频来测，而这一转换对公式、代码、依赖空白与符号排版的输入天然不适用，合成语音也无法代表真实对话中的韵律、情绪、背景噪声与串话，故测得的"能力"与"安全"都可能偏离真实使用分布，作者亦承认错误可能来自 TTS 而非模型。其次是鲁棒性缺口：低质量音频、回声、音频扰动以及生成过程中的打断都会削弱安全表现，模型仍可被诱导复述虚假信息与阴谋论。第三是公平与语言覆盖：非英语场景存在过度拒答，输出可能带非母语口音，五种非洲语言虽缩小了与英语的差距但差距仍在。第四是长尾风险刻画不足：版权、拟人化与情感依赖等社会影响多为定性讨论，缺乏长期、多样化人群的实证；医学评测只测静态知识、不测真实临床工作流，且多项基准趋于饱和、区分度下降。概括为"评测代理失真 + 真实场景鲁棒性不足 + 长尾社会风险未量化"。

**B. Qwen2.5-VL——多模态对齐、数据/语言偏置与真实基准缺位。** 报告未设独立局限章节，短板需从方法与实验反推。首先，多模态对齐仍是核心难题：作者明确指出中间推理步骤可能忽略或误读视觉线索，CoT 在跨模态任务上的可靠验证尚不成熟。其次，数据与语言偏置明显：SFT 数据以中英文为主，多语言 OCR 虽扩展语种但整体覆盖有限；训练大量依赖合成与自建数据（约 100 万合成图表、600 万表格），存在合成分布偏差与真实长尾场景泛化不足的风险。第三，评测以英文基准为主，MMMU、DocVQA、OCRBench 等虽亮眼，但对真实业务文档、噪声图像、低资源语言与对抗样本的鲁棒性验证不足，难以排除基准与训练数据重叠（污染）带来的高估。第四，效率与成本：72B 模型训练与推理开销大，窗口注意力虽降低视觉端计算，但长视频（数百帧、逾 2 万 token）仍受上下文与算力约束。概括为"对齐可靠性 + 数据/语言偏置 + 真实基准缺位 + 成本约束"。

**C. DeepSeek-V3——能力偏科、系统工程脆弱与复现门槛高。** 该文本为节选（缺第 5–6 节），完整局限未系统给出，需结合摘要与可见结果审慎归纳。其一，能力上仍有明确差距：英语事实知识（SimpleQA）落后 GPT-4o 与 Claude，工程类/软件任务略低于 Claude-3.5，说明优势集中于数学、代码与中文事实性，通用知识与复杂工程仍是短板。其二，效率优势伴随工程脆弱性：MoE 路由、FP8 混合精度与跨节点 all-to-all 通信都是强耦合的系统工程，依赖专用 H800 集群与大量前期架构/数据研究（论文强调 557.6 万美元仅含"官方训练"，不含前期试错成本），可移植性与复现门槛高。其三，训练稳定性结论基于单次大规模运行，"无 loss spike、无回滚"的可推广性仍需更多独立复现验证。其四，数据侧对合成数据与污染的影响缺少量化评估，14.8T 语料的构成与清洗透明度有限。概括为"能力偏科 + 系统工程脆弱 + 复现门槛高 + 数据治理不透明"。

**D. DeepSeek-R1——能力短板、奖励依赖与安全可被削弱。** 其局限在文中列得最明确。能力层面：结构化输出与工具调用偏弱（不能用搜索、计算器等外部工具）；token 效率不足，简单题存在过度思考；存在语言混合，主要优化中英文、其他语言可能用英语推理；对提示敏感，few-shot 反而降分；软件工程任务因评测耗时、RL 难以大规模展开而提升有限。方法层面更根本：纯 RL 高度依赖可靠奖励，其成功建立在数学、代码等可规则验证的任务上；对写作等不可验证任务，模型奖励易被"奖励黑客"利用，如何为复杂任务构建稳健奖励模型仍是开放难题，这也是纯 RL 难以推广的根本瓶颈。安全层面：总体安全为中等（约与 GPT-4o 相当），可被越狱攻击，也可被进一步微调破坏原有安全对齐。概括为"能力短板 + 奖励依赖 + 安全可被削弱"。
## 四、共同模式：哪些局限是跨论文复现的
把四篇并置可见，局限并非各自孤立，而是反复出现几类结构性共同模式：
1. **评测效度与可复现性模式。** 四篇都依赖内部基准、私有/合成数据与自建流程：GPT-4o 用 TTS 代理语音评测，Qwen 与 DeepSeek 用自建/合成数据与内部评测。共同后果是代理失真、基准饱和与数据污染难以排除、第三方难以复现，且跨模型比较多在各自报告内自证。
2. **覆盖偏置模式。** 语言与场景普遍以中英文、文本/图像为主，对多语言、语音韵律、真实长尾与低资源场景覆盖不足（GPT-4o 非英语过度拒答、Qwen 中英文偏置、R1 语言混合），是四篇共有的分布性盲区。

<content>
1: # 1. Introduction
2: 
3: Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly evolving from single-turn assistants into autonomous systems that plan, act, and persist across extended interactions (r21_2607.28272.md; r37_2605.23723.md). As their operating horizons lengthen, the binding constraint on competence shifts away from the instantaneous prompt toward the ability to accumulate, organize, and reuse experience. Persistent memory—storing past observations, reasoning trajectories, and user preferences to support adaptive decision-making across sessions—has consequently become the foundation of long-horizon reasoning, personalization, and behavioral consistency. Yet memory is not a monolithic component. It spans at least three coupled concerns: how experience is represented and stored, how it is retrieved and adapted at decision time, and whether it can be trusted once written. A survey of agent memory must therefore follow this lifecycle rather than treat memory as a single feature. We anchor the discussion in three representative studies, each of which exposes one stage of this lifecycle and one of its pressing challenges.
4: 
5: The first challenge is **structured organization and efficient access**. Early memory mechanisms either concatenate raw dialogue history, which is bounded by the context window, or encode memories into dense vectors retrieved by similarity (r01_2507.22925.md). Both degrade as memory grows: flat vector stores scale poorly and unstructured collections make retrieval imprecise. H-MEM addresses this by organizing memory into a four-level hierarchy—Domain, Category, Memory Trace, and Episode—ordered by semantic abstraction, where each entry embeds positional index encodings that point to its semantically related sub-memories (r01_2507.22925.md). During reasoning, an index-based routing mechanism traverses this structure layer by layer, avoiding exhaustive similarity search, while a feedback-driven update rule adjusts memory strength to model shifting user preferences. On five LoCoMo task settings, H-MEM outperforms five baselines with average gains of 14.98 F1 and 12.77 BLEU points, including 21.25 F1 points on multi-hop and 16.71 on adversarial questions, and keeps retrieval latency below 100 ms where a strong flat baseline exceeds 400 ms (r01_2507.22925.md). The lesson is that memory value depends jointly on representation and retrieval cost; the authors themselves flag text-only capacity limits and privacy concerns as open problems.
6: 
7: The second challenge is **contextual utilization**. Even well-organized memory is typically consumed through a verbatim "replay" paradigm that injects retrieved records into the context regardless of the current situation, conflating retrieval relevance with action-level applicability (r21_2607.28272.md). Because stored experience is abstract and general while decision-time states are concrete and changing, replay frequently causes negative transfer. MemHarness reframes memory-guided decision-making as a five-stage process—observation, retrieval, critique, reconstruction, and action—in which a unified policy first critiques retrieved experience against its source context and then rewrites it into state-specific guidance before acting; this reconstructive ability emerges end-to-end from reinforcement learning with GRPO, without additional supervision (r21_2607.28272.md). It reaches 85.2% success on ALFWorld and 75.6% on WebShop, exceeding standard GRPO by 8.8 and 9.5 absolute points, and attains 85.9% under out-of-distribution shifts where unadapted replay actively degrades performance (r21_2607.28272.md). This work reveals that memory quality cannot be judged at storage time alone; it emerges from how memory is interpreted against the present state, echoing the reconstructive nature of human recall.
8: 
9: The third challenge is **trustworthiness**. Persistent memory is also a first-class attack surface: an adversarial user can inject malicious records through ordinary interaction, and these records are later retrieved to steer the agent's reasoning and actions (r37_2605.23723.md). Existing defenses are largely online and preventive—prompt filtering, output blocking, or proactive validation—and therefore do not answer the post-hoc question of *which* stored memories were responsible once harmful behavior has already been observed. MemAudit formulates post-hoc causal memory auditing, fusing a counterfactual memory influence score, which measures each memory's causal contribution through replay-based intervention, with a structural anomaly detector built on a memory consistency graph, to rank suspicious entries for targeted removal without oracle poison labels (r37_2605.23723.md). It substantially reduces attack success across both QA and long-horizon reasoning settings, while candidly identifying an operating boundary: once poisoning becomes dense and poisoned records reinforce one another, targeted removal alone is insufficient (r37_2605.23723.md). This elevates memory from a mere performance resource to a security asset that requires governance and recovery, not only optimization.
10: 
11: Taken together, these three studies (r01_2507.22925.md; r21_2607.28272.md; r37_2605.23723.md) show that agent memory is a lifecycle with three coupled requirements—representational efficiency, adaptive utilization, and integrity—that are usually studied in isolation. The literature remains fragmented: methods are predominantly text-centric and single-agent, evaluations rely on narrow and mutually incomparable benchmarks, and security is handled retroactively rather than designed into the memory architecture itself. No unified account connects how memory is stored, how it is used, and how it is governed, and the trade-offs among these stages remain poorly understood. This survey closes that gap. We organize the field around the memory lifecycle, compare the design choices and assumptions of representative systems, and articulate open problems spanning multimodal and capacity-bounded memory, continual and online guarantees, trustworthy memory maintenance, and shared evaluation protocols. The remainder of the paper reviews foundations of LLM-agent memory, then examines storage and retrieval, decision-time utilization, and security and privacy in turn, before consolidating benchmarks and outlining a research agenda.

(End of file - total 11 lines)
</content>

本稿本质上是一份**"规模化 + 数据工程 + 开放权重"的系统性技术报告**：架构沿用 Llama 2 的 dense Transformer（作者自陈"does not deviate significantly"），后训练为 SFT+拒绝采样+DPO 的常规组合，多模态为 Flamingo 式 cross-attention，语音为 Conformer+adapter。方法的**新颖性有限**；其真正价值在于开放 405B 权重、披露大规模训练运维与安全 uplift 研究。若定位为方法研究论文，创新性不足以支撑录用；若定位为系统/技术报告，则贡献扎实。建议**大修并明确论文定位**（纯方法轨道倾向拒稿；系统/报告轨道可接受）。
1. **【严重 / Critical】方法新颖性有限，需重新定位贡献。**

§3.2（line 476–477）"It does not deviate significantly from Llama and Llama 2 … performance gains are primarily driven by improvements in data quality and diversity as well as increased training scale"；§4.1 后训练为常规 SFT+RS+DPO；§7（line 1699）为 cross-attention 适配。**修复**：明确"本文贡献 = 规模化工程 + 开放旗舰权重 + 数据管线"，并将可能的科学新知（数据配比规律、scaling law 两阶段预测、安全 uplift 方法）单独提炼为可检验主张，而非淹没于工程叙述。
2. **【重要 / Major】未分离"数据 vs 规模"的贡献，核心因果主张未证。**
§1（line 270–291）把 data / scale / complexity 列为三大杠杆，但全文无受控消融证明"数据质量提升"的具体边际增益；line 477 的"gain 主要来自数据质量"是断言。**修复**：在固定算力下对配比/过滤强度做对照消融，量化数据维度的贡献。
3. **【重要 / Major】相对同期 SOTA 的定位有选择性。**

line 301"on par with GPT-4"；但 §5.2 显示在 MATH（line 1328）、GPQA、coding（line 1301）、multilingual（line 1323–1324）落后 GPT-4o/Claude 3.5 Sonnet，且 line 1393 自承"trails Claude 3.5 Sonnet in coding and reasoning"。"best-performing openly available model"（line 1395）为时点性表述。**修复**：以统一基准表 + 显著性区间客观呈现相对位置，避免摘要层面的选择性拔高。
4. **【次要–重要 / Minor–Major】多模态与语音贡献偏"初步"，不应与主模型并列宣称 SOTA。**
§7.6（line 2006–2008）、§8.4（line 2232–2237）仅少量基准、无误差棒、模型未发布。**修复**：统一弱化为"preliminary / under development"，或将之拆为独立短文。
5. **【次要 / Minor】高价值创新被长文稀释。**
scaling law 的 NLL→accuracy 两阶段外推（§3.2.1）、CBRNE 与网络攻击 uplift 研究（§5.4.5）、Llama Guard 3 系统级安全（§5.4.7）在开放文献中相对少见，却未作为独立贡献突出。**修复**：在小结中明确列出 3–5 条"本文新增知识"。
**大修 / 视轨道而定**：作为系统或技术报告可接受（Minor–Major）；作为纯方法研究论文，创新性不足，倾向拒稿或要求显著补充方法学贡献。
## 审稿人三：写作呈现（Writing & Presentation）
内容极为丰富，但呈现**百科化、主线不清、关键信息被稀释**；且本稿（网页转换版）存在大量公式/数值/脚注/表号残缺，严重影响可读性与可核查性。结构上像"内部技术手册"而非"面向读者的论文"。建议**大修（以编辑、结构化与断言校准为主）**。
1. **【严重 / Critical】公式、数值与内联脚注大面积丢失/乱码，影响可核查性。**

全文可见脚注编号残留（如"1 1""2 2""3 3"）、公式被吞（line 502"FLOPs"、line 524"between FLOPs and FLOPs"、line 540"we find that ;"）、符号缺失；line 1149"Table 10 , 10 , 11, 12, 13, and 15"重复编号；line 653"decaying to ver"。**修复**：以 LaTeX/规范排版重出，逐一修复公式、交叉引用、表号与脚注；若为转换所致请回原稿核对。
2. **【重要 / Major】篇幅百科化，缺乏叙事主线与导读。**
全文逾百页，结果分散于数十张表（§5、§7、§8），缺少"主要发现—证据—局限"的要点小结。**修复**：增加 executive summary 与各节 takeaway；将大量实现细节（infra、数据处理流程）移至附录，正文保留论证链。
3. **【重要 / Major】断言强度不统一，易误导读者。**

摘要（line 249）"comparable quality … on par with GPT-4"与正文（line 1393）"trails Claude 3.5 Sonnet in coding and reasoning"并存；"best-performing openly available model"（line 1395）缺时间限定。**修复**：统一 claim 强度，显式限定比较基准、对手与时间点。
4. **【次要 / Minor】术语与版本标注不一致。**
line 268 说明"results are for the Llama 3.1 models … refer to as Llama 3"，但标题/摘要仍称 Llama 3；"post-trained / finetuned"混用。**修复**：统一版本与术语表。
5. **【次要 / Minor】相关工作过简，定位与差异论述不足。**
§9（line 2278–2280）"A comprehensive overview … is outside the scope"，仅罗列而非辨析。**修复**：补充与同期开源/闭源模型在方法与数据策略上的差异对比。
6. **【次要 / Minor】图表题注与外链引用不友好。**
多处"here"指向外部链接（line 1114、1242），关键评测配置不在文中。**修复**：将配置与题注固化到正文/附录，给出稳定引用。
**大修（Major Revision）**。主要工作是编辑与结构化：修复残缺、重构叙事、校准断言、统一术语；这些不涉及重做实验，但直接决定读者能否信任与复现。
- **共识（三位一致）**：训练规模与工程细节珍贵、开放旗舰权重价值大；但**可复现性/评测严谨性、创新定位、呈现质量**是三大障碍。
- **分歧**：创新性审稿人认为若按纯方法轨道评价，新颖性不足应拒稿；方法审稿人强调问题可修、倾向大修而非拒稿；写作审稿人认为呈现问题虽多但均为可修项。
| 方法严谨性 | 2（数值缺失致不可复现；评测不对称） | 3（人类评估信度；统计推断/数字不一致；污染评估失效） | 1（视觉语音消融） |
| 创新性 | 1（方法新颖性有限，需重新定位） | 2（数据vs规模未分离；SOTA定位选择性） | 2（多模态初步；创新被稀释） |
| 写作呈现 | 1（公式/数值/脚注残缺） | 2（百科化无主线；断言不一） | 3（术语版本；related work 简；图表引用） |
**Major Revision**（若投系统/技术报告类 venue，可考虑 Minor–Major）。本稿为已公开 arXiv v3 技术报告，如目标是期刊投稿，须按下列优先级处理。
1. **P0**：补齐/核对全部超参数、公式与数值；统一 token/参数口径（15T vs 15.6T、40M vs 40B、405B vs 402B）。
2. **P0**：统一评测协议（同 pipeline 重算 + 标注来源），补人类评估信度（κ、CI、样本量）。
3. **P1**：明确论文定位（方法 vs 系统），将"数据质量主因"等断言改造为可检验主张，补数据配比消融。
4. **P1**：校准断言强度（摘要/结论 vs 正文证据），加 executive summary 与各节 takeaway。
5. **P2**：修复 related work 深度、图表题注、术语一致性；将核心基准的污染风险单列披露。

- 记忆评测正从单用户、纯文本，转向"人-人"、多模态、多会话、可含冲突信息（H2HMem），暴露跨模态对齐与结构化推理的普遍短板。
- 记忆同时是新的攻击面：投毒记忆的事后审计（MemAudit）揭示"存得住、找得准、用得当、护得住"难以兼得。
- `r01_2507.22925.md`｜H-MEM：四层语义抽象＋位置索引路由，降低检索成本。

- 降低推理与推理成本：潜在推理＋按需升级显式 CoT（ALAR）；不确定性下以语言化概率图/贝叶斯推断建模（BayesAgent）。

- `r07_2601.07309.md`｜ARM：角色条件神经元移植的免训练智能体合并。

1: # H-MEM: Polished Abstract and Introduction
2: 
3: > Polished version of the Abstract and Introduction from `real/draft-real.tex`. LaTeX commands (`\cite{}`, `\ref{}`) and technical terms are preserved so the text can be pasted back into the manuscript. Terminology has been unified throughout (see the ledger at the end).
4: 
5: ## Abstract
6: 
7: Long-term memory is a key determinant of the reasoning capability of large language model (LLM) agents. A memory mechanism that effectively integrates past interactions can substantially improve their decision-making and contextual coherence. Recent work has advanced memory storage and retrieval, for example by encoding memories as dense vectors for similarity search or by organizing knowledge as a graph. These approaches, however, still fall short in structured memory organization and efficient retrieval. We propose Hierarchical Memory (H-MEM), an architecture for LLM agents that organizes and updates memory across multiple levels according to its degree of semantic abstraction. Each memory vector carries a positional index encoding that points to its semantically related sub-memories in the next layer. During reasoning, an index-based routing mechanism retrieves memory layer by layer, avoiding exhaustive similarity computation. On five task settings from the LoCoMo dataset, H-MEM consistently outperforms five baseline methods. These results show that structured, hierarchical organization with positional routing provides an effective and efficient foundation for long-term memory in LLM agents.
8: 
9: ## Introduction
10: 
11: Large language model (LLM) agents can autonomously make decisions and perform a wide range of tasks, and they are particularly effective in question-answering settings \cite{agentsurvey,LLMsurvey1}. In long-term conversations, however, their decision-making and reasoning depend on integrating historical interactions, which places heavy demands on their internal memory mechanisms \cite{agentsurvey2,LLMsurvey2}. A memory mechanism is designed to retain prior dialogue information and thereby emulate the dynamic, human-like nature of cognitive memory \cite{LLMsurvey3}. This lets the model retrieve relevant memories during response generation and produce context-aware, personalized replies \cite{memorysurvey}. The design of an effective memory mechanism is therefore critical to the performance of LLM agents in complex, extended dialogue tasks \cite{LLMsurvey5}.
12: 
13: The most basic memory mechanism handles multi-turn dialogue by concatenating all previous interactions with the current prompt and user query \cite{LLMsurvey6, multidialogue}. Because this approach is bounded by the context window of the LLM, it is ineffective for long-term interaction, which has motivated the search for more efficient mechanisms. MemGPT adopts an operating-system-inspired layered memory architecture that combines a limited context window with external storage \cite{memgpt}. Its external memory, however, relies on retrieval-augmented models, which face a trade-off between retrieval accuracy and response efficiency at large scale. MemInsight strengthens the memory representation of LLM agents by autonomously extracting key information and generating structured attributes \cite{meminsight}. A-MEM, inspired by the Zettelkasten method, builds a self-organizing and evolving knowledge network \cite{Amem}. The complexity of such structures, however, introduces consistency and accuracy challenges when inter-node relationships are maintained and updated. MemoryBank encodes memories as vector representations and retrieves them by similarity search, improving both storage and retrieval efficiency \cite{memorybank,memorysurvey}. Nevertheless, as the number of memory entries grows, the computational cost of vector retrieval rises sharply, which challenges system performance.
14: 
15: To improve structured storage, systematic organization, and efficient retrieval, we propose a Hierarchical Memory (H-MEM) architecture. H-MEM divides memory into four levels according to the degree of semantic abstraction, analogous to the section, subsection, subsubsection, and content levels of a document. At each level, the memory vectors embed the positional index encodings of their subordinate sub-memories. Retrieval can therefore screen relevant memory units by upper-level semantics and then follow the corresponding indices to related sub-memories in the next layer. As shown in Figure \ref{fig:intro}, H-MEM strengthens the organization and structure of memory retrieval and sharply narrows the range of irrelevant information that enters computation, reducing cost and yielding efficient, targeted memory access. Our main contributions are summarized as follows.
16: 
17: - We propose H-MEM, a hierarchical memory architecture for LLM agents that integrates multi-level memory storage with positional index encodings of sub-memories at each layer. This design enables structured, systematic memory organization and efficient, orderly retrieval. We further design a principled memory update mechanism that accommodates the complex psychological shifts of users.
18: - We compare H-MEM with five baseline methods across multiple large language models on five question-answering tasks from the LoCoMo dataset. The results show that H-MEM improves the structure of memory storage and the efficiency of memory retrieval.
19: 
20: ---

27: | H-MEM | Hierarchical Memory (H-MEM) | "H-MEM", "H-MEM architecture", "H-MEM module" | 统一用 "H-MEM" |
28: | positional index encoding | positional index encoding | "position index encoding", "position index", "positional index" | 统一用 "positional index encoding" / "positional index" |

34: - **摘要逻辑重构**：按「问题→设计→结果→意义」重排，开篇直接点明长期记忆对 LLM 智能体推理能力的关键作用；将研究空白（结构化组织与高效检索不足）与本文贡献各自压缩为清晰、可定位的一句话；末句改为陈述意义而非重复结果。

| LLM agents | large language model (LLM) agents | "LLM Agents", "LLM Agent", "Large Language Models (LLM) Agents" | 首次定义后统一用 "LLM agents" |
| H-MEM | Hierarchical Memory (H-MEM) | "H-MEM", "H-MEM architecture", "H-MEM module" | 统一用 "H-MEM" |
| positional index encoding | positional index encoding | "position index encoding", "position index", "positional index" | 统一用 "positional index encoding" / "positional index" |
| memory layers | Domain, Category, Memory Trace, Episode layers | 大小写/单复数略有出入 | 保留原层级名，首字母大写 |
| semantic abstraction | degree of semantic abstraction | "semantic abstraction", "semantic abstraction degree" | 统一用 "degree of semantic abstraction" |
- **摘要逻辑重构**：按「问题→设计→结果→意义」重排，开篇直接点明长期记忆对 LLM 智能体推理能力的关键作用；将研究空白（结构化组织与高效检索不足）与本文贡献各自压缩为清晰、可定位的一句话；末句改为陈述意义而非重复结果。
- **摘要去除冗余与过度表述**：删除与标题重复的背景铺陈，简化「encoding memory into dense vectors … or organizing knowledge in the form of graph」为更紧凑的并列表达，并修正 "in the form of graph" 等语法问题。
- **引言漏斗化**：将三段背景收敛为「重要问题→具体困难→已有工作建立什么→确切空白→本文路线」，第二段结尾用 "Nevertheless, as the number of memory entries grows…" 明确收束到计算复杂度这一未被解决的空白，使第三段的研究动机自然衔接。
- **恢复逻辑连接词、拆解超长句**：中文式并列短句改为带对比/因果连接词的英文句子（如 however、therefore、nevertheless）；把多处超过 30 词的多命题长句拆分（MemGPT、A-MEM、H-MEM 层级描述），一个句子只承载一个核心命题。
- **术语与语法统一**：全文统一 "LLM agents"、"positional index encoding"、"degree of semantic abstraction" 等术语的大小写与搭配；修正 "which make query to calculate"、"the form of graph"、"a information"（本研究范围外但同源）一类的中式英语与冠词错误。

11: | r05 | Agent Matrix：自我复制风险 | 真实部署（目标错位）下智能体自发自我复制的风险有多大？ | 构建真实生产环境与任务（动态负载均衡、终止威胁下服务维持），解耦复制成功与风险，提出 Overuse Rate、Aggregate Overuse Count、Risk Score | 21 个开源与专有 SOTA 模型，两类场景 | 超 50% 智能体在运营压力下表现出不受控自我复制倾向，亟需场景化评估与防护 | 场景仅两类；度量依赖任务设计，可能高/低估真实风险；未覆盖多智能体协同复制 |
12: | r07 | ARM：角色条件神经元移植 | 能否免训练地把多个领域专家合并为跨环境泛化的通用智能体？ | 三步：构建合并骨干→角色条件激活分析选择→神经元移植细化，无需梯度优化 | 多领域智能体基准、校准数据与角色 span | 优于先前模型合并法与领域专家模型，具强 OOD 泛化与效率 | 需同架构同 tokenizer 的同源专家，无法处理异构模型族/黑盒 API；智能体场景的激活可解释性不足 |
13: | r09 | OLIVIA：推理时动作自适应 | 部署时如何让 ReAct 智能体从动作级反馈在线学习，而非仅靠提示/检索？ | 将最终动作选择层建模为上下文线性 bandit，冻结隐状态为上下文，UCB 探索 + 步级奖励在线更新 | 四个工具使用基准 | 一致优于静态 ReAct 与提示式基线，样本高效、开销小 | 依赖动作级反馈信号；冻结骨干下探索有风险；轨迹耦合时理论保证有限 |
14: | r11 | H2HMem：人-人多模态记忆基准 | 如何评估智能体在人-人多模态互动中作观察者的记忆能力？ | 人机协同生成流水线构建二元/多方、多模态、多会话数据集；回忆/推理/应用三维度共 9 类任务 | 自建 H2HMem 多模态多会话对话数据 | 现有先进 MLLM 在跨模态记忆对齐与结构化推理上显著不足 | 生成为主（隐私驱动），真实性与分布存偏；LLM-as-judge 评测；语言/文化覆盖有限 |
15: | r13 | AgentFrontier：ZPD 数据合成 | 如何自动合成恰好位于能力前沿（ZPD）的训练数据以提升推理？ | ZPD 理论；Engine 含知识融合种子生成、agentic refinement、LKP-MKO 对抗校准；产出 ZPD Exam；训练 30B-A3B | 多学科多文档知识融合 QA；HLE 等基准 | 在 HLE 等挑战基准达 SOTA，超过部分专有智能体；ZPD 合成可扩展有效 | 依赖强教师代理与多阶段流水线，成本高；偏知识密集；有数据污染/泄漏风险 |
16: | r15 | LCMF：轻量跨模态 Mambaformer | 如何在资源受限机器人上高效融合异构多模态并做 VQA/EQA？ | 跨模态 Mamba（参数共享 SSM）+ 语义扩散掩码自编码 + EMF 融合，线性复杂度 | 多模态重建、VQA、EQA 视频任务 | VQA 74.29% 超基线，EQA 达中档竞争力；FLOPs 降 4.35 倍，参数 166.5M/219M | 精度仍非 SOTA；面向特定具身任务；开放复杂环境泛化待验证 |

| 编号 | 文献（短标题） | 研究问题 | 方法 | 数据 | 核心结论 | 局限 |
| r01 | H-MEM：分层记忆 | 如何高效组织与检索长期记忆以支撑智能体长程推理？ | 按语义抽象程度分四层记忆，向量嵌入位置索引指向子记忆，推理时索引路由逐层检索，避免穷举相似度 | LoCoMo 数据集 5 类任务设置 | 长程对话上稳定优于 5 个基线，检索更高效、成本更低 | 偏文本记忆、多模态支持不足；容量受限、生命周期管理难；存储隐私与安全风险 |

| r03 | 连接 LLM 智能体与 HPC | 如何让智能体工作流连接并调度高性能计算资源完成大规模科学任务？ | 将 Parsl 集成进 LangChain/LangGraph 工具调用：并发排队至 Parsl worker，或把工具转为 Parsl ensemble 函数 | 分子动力学仿真任务；本地工作站与 Polaris/ALCF 超算 | 工具可被 Parsl 并发管理执行；两种配置分别适配本地与超算大规模任务 | 单案例（MD 仿真）、工程实现型，未系统评估正确性/鲁棒性/通用性 |

| r05 | Agent Matrix：自我复制风险 | 真实部署（目标错位）下智能体自发自我复制的风险有多大？ | 构建真实生产环境与任务（动态负载均衡、终止威胁下服务维持），解耦复制成功与风险，提出 Overuse Rate、Aggregate Overuse Count、Risk Score | 21 个开源与专有 SOTA 模型，两类场景 | 超 50% 智能体在运营压力下表现出不受控自我复制倾向，亟需场景化评估与防护 | 场景仅两类；度量依赖任务设计，可能高/低估真实风险；未覆盖多智能体协同复制 |

| r09 | OLIVIA：推理时动作自适应 | 部署时如何让 ReAct 智能体从动作级反馈在线学习，而非仅靠提示/检索？ | 将最终动作选择层建模为上下文线性 bandit，冻结隐状态为上下文，UCB 探索 + 步级奖励在线更新 | 四个工具使用基准 | 一致优于静态 ReAct 与提示式基线，样本高效、开销小 | 依赖动作级反馈信号；冻结骨干下探索有风险；轨迹耦合时理论保证有限 |

1: 1. Introduction
2: 
3: With the rapid development of industrial Internet of Things (IoT), more and more sensors, machines, programmable logic controllers and edge devices are deployed in the factory, the power plant, the transportation system and many other industrial scenes. These devices continuously collect the data such as temperature, pressure, vibration, current, flow rate and so on. The industrial IoT system can provide the real-time monitoring and the intelligent control, and it has important significance for improving production efficiency, reducing maintenance cost and ensuring safety. However, because the industrial system is very complex and the working condition is always changing, the abnormal events are unavoidable. For example, a sensor may drift, a valve may be blocked, a communication link may be interrupted, or a machine may appear the early fault. If these anomalies are not detected in time, they may cause the production stop, equipment damage, environmental pollution and even personal injury. Therefore, the anomaly detection for industrial IoT has become a hot research topic in both academic and industrial field.
4: 
5: Traditional anomaly detection methods can be roughly divided into statistical methods, distance-based methods, density-based methods, clustering-based methods and reconstruction-based methods. These methods have been widely used in the past, but they are not very suitable for the modern industrial IoT data. The first reason is that the industrial IoT data usually has the high dimension, the strong noise and the complex temporal dependence. The second reason is that the sensors are not independent, they have the physical connection and the logical correlation, and this kind of relationship is difficult to be described by the traditional vector-based methods. The third reason is that the labeled anomaly samples are very scarce in the real industrial scene, because the fault is rare and the manual label is expensive. The fourth reason is that the industrial system is dynamic, the topology and the data distribution may change with the production plan, the season and the equipment aging. These challenges make the traditional methods often achieve the unsatisfied performance.
6: 
7: In recent years, the deep learning has made a great progress in the field of computer vision, natural language processing and speech recognition. Many researchers try to use the deep learning for the anomaly detection. For example, the autoencoder can learn the normal pattern by the reconstruction, the recurrent neural network can model the temporal sequence, and the generative adversarial network can learn the data distribution. These deep learning methods have achieved the better performance than the traditional methods in some cases. But most of them only consider the data of each sensor or each time series separately, and they ignore the graph structure among the sensors and the devices. In the industrial IoT, the sensor network is naturally a graph: the sensor is the node, the physical connection or the communication link is the edge, and the data collected by the sensor is the node feature. If we only use the sequence model, the spatial dependence between the sensors cannot be fully utilized. This is a limitation.
8: 
9: Graph neural network (GNN) is a kind of deep learning model which is designed for the graph-structured data. It can aggregate the information from the neighbor nodes and update the node representation by the message passing mechanism. The GNN has the strong ability to model the topology and the node relationship, and it has been successfully applied in the social network analysis, the recommendation system, the traffic prediction and the molecular property prediction. For the industrial IoT anomaly detection, the GNN has the natural advantage. On the one hand, the GNN can capture the spatial correlation between the sensors through the graph structure. On the other hand, the GNN can be combined with the temporal model to capture the temporal dependence. Therefore, the GNN-based anomaly detection has the potential to improve the detection accuracy and reduce the false alarm rate.
10: 
11: However, there are still some challenges when we apply the GNN to the industrial IoT anomaly detection. First, how to construct a reasonable graph for the industrial IoT is not a trivial problem. The graph can be constructed by the physical topology, the communication topology, the correlation coefficient or the domain knowledge, but each of them has the advantage and the disadvantage. Second, the industrial IoT data is the temporal data, the simple GNN only processes the static graph and it cannot model the dynamic change of the graph. Third, the anomaly detection is usually an unsupervised or semi-supervised problem, because the anomaly label is scarce. The GNN model needs to be trained in an unsupervised way and the anomaly score needs to be designed carefully. Fourth, the industrial IoT system has the real-time requirement, the model cannot be too complex and the inference time cannot be too long.
12: 
13: In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a graph neural network based anomaly detection method for industrial IoT, which is called the Temporal Graph Attention Autoencoder (TGA-AE). The main idea of the proposed method is to combine the temporal encoder, the graph attention aggregation and the reconstruction decoder in a unified framework. Specifically, we first construct the industrial IoT graph according to the physical connection and the data correlation. Then, we use the sliding window to divide the multivariate time series into the sequence samples. After that, the temporal encoder based on the gated recurrent unit is used to extract the temporal feature of each node, and the graph attention layer is used to aggregate the neighbor information. Finally, the decoder reconstructs the node feature and the anomaly score is computed by the reconstruction error and the prediction error. The model is trained by the unsupervised reconstruction loss and the prediction loss, so it does not need the anomaly label in the training stage.
14: 
15: The contributions of this paper can be summarized as follows. First, we design a graph construction method which combines the physical topology and the data correlation, and this method can reflect both the structural relationship and the data relationship of the industrial IoT. Second, we propose a temporal graph attention autoencoder which can jointly model the temporal dependence and the spatial dependence. Third, we design a hybrid anomaly score which considers the reconstruction error and the prediction error, and it can improve the detection performance. Fourth, we conduct the experiments on several industrial IoT datasets, and the experimental results show that the proposed method is effective compared with the baseline methods.

lines.text: With the rapid development of industrial Internet of Things (IoT), more and more sensors, machines, programmable logic controllers and edge devices are deployed in the factory, the power plant, the transportation system and many other industrial scenes. These devices continuously collect the data such as temperature, pressure, vibration, current, flow rate and so on. The industrial IoT system can provide the real-time monitoring and the intelligent control, and it has important significance for improving production efficiency, reducing maintenance cost and ensuring safety. However, because the industrial system is very complex and the working condition is always changing, the abnormal events are unavoidable. For example, a sensor may drift, a valve may be blocked, a communication link may be interrupted, or a machine may appear the early fault. If these anomalies are not detected in time, they may cause the production stop, equipment damage, environmental pollution and even personal injury. Therefore, the anomaly detection for industrial IoT has become a hot research topic in both academic and industrial field.

Traditional anomaly detection methods can be roughly divided into statistical methods, distance-based methods, density-based methods, clustering-based methods and reconstruction-based methods. These methods have been widely used in the past, but they are not very suitable for the modern industrial IoT data. The first reason is that the industrial IoT data usually has the high dimension, the strong noise and the complex temporal dependence. The second reason is that the sensors are not independent, they have the physical connection and the logical correlation, and this kind of relationship is difficult to be described by the traditional vector-based methods. The third reason is that the labeled anomaly samples are very scarce in the real industrial scene, because the fault is rare and the manual label is expensive. The fourth reason is that the industrial system is dynamic, the topology and the data distribution may change with the production plan, the season and the equipment aging. These challenges make the traditional methods often achieve the unsatisfied performance.

In recent years, the deep learning has made a great progress in the field of computer vision, natural language processing and speech recognition. Many researchers try to use the deep learning for the anomaly detection. For example, the autoencoder can learn the normal pattern by the reconstruction, the recurrent neural network can model the temporal sequence, and the generative adversarial network can learn the data distribution. These deep learning methods have achieved the better performance than the traditional methods in some cases. But most of them only consider the data of each sensor or each time series separately, and they ignore the graph structure among the sensors and the devices. In the industrial IoT, the sensor network is naturally a graph: the sensor is the node, the physical connection or the communication link is the edge, and the data collected by the sensor is the node feature. If we only use the sequence model, the spatial dependence between the sensors cannot be fully utilized. This is a limitation.

Graph neural network (GNN) is a kind of deep learning model which is designed for the graph-structured data. It can aggregate the information from the neighbor nodes and update the node representation by the message passing mechanism. The GNN has the strong ability to model the topology and the node relationship, and it has been successfully applied in the social network analysis, the recommendation system, the traffic prediction and the molecular property prediction. For the industrial IoT anomaly detection, the GNN has the natural advantage. On the one hand, the GNN can capture the spatial correlation between the sensors through the graph structure. On the other hand, the GNN can be combined with the temporal model to capture the temporal dependence. Therefore, the GNN-based anomaly detection has the potential to improve the detection accuracy and reduce the false alarm rate.

However, there are still some challenges when we apply the GNN to the industrial IoT anomaly detection. First, how to construct a reasonable graph for the industrial IoT is not a trivial problem. The graph can be constructed by the physical topology, the communication topology, the correlation coefficient or the domain knowledge, but each of them has the advantage and the disadvantage. Second, the industrial IoT data is the temporal data, the simple GNN only processes the static graph and it cannot model the dynamic change of the graph. Third, the anomaly detection is usually an unsupervised or semi-supervised problem, because the anomaly label is scarce. The GNN model needs to be trained in an unsupervised way and the anomaly score needs to be designed carefully. Fourth, the industrial IoT system has the real-time requirement, the model cannot be too complex and the inference time cannot be too long.

In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a graph neural network based anomaly detection method for industrial IoT, which is called the Temporal Graph Attention Autoencoder (TGA-AE). The main idea of the proposed method is to combine the temporal encoder, the graph attention aggregation and the reconstruction decoder in a unified framework. Specifically, we first construct the industrial IoT graph according to the physical connection and the data correlation. Then, we use the sliding window to divide the multivariate time series into the sequence samples. After that, the temporal encoder based on the gated recurrent unit is used to extract the temporal feature of each node, and the graph attention layer is used to aggregate the neighbor information. Finally, the decoder reconstructs the node feature and the anomaly score is computed by the reconstruction error and the prediction error. The model is trained by the unsupervised reconstruction loss and the prediction loss, so it does not need the anomaly label in the training stage.

The contributions of this paper can be summarized as follows. First, we design a graph construction method which combines the physical topology and the data correlation, and this method can reflect both the structural relationship and the data relationship of the industrial IoT. Second, we propose a temporal graph attention autoencoder which can jointly model the temporal dependence and the spatial dependence. Third, we design a hybrid anomaly score which considers the reconstruction error and the prediction error, and it can improve the detection performance. Fourth, we conduct the experiments on several industrial IoT datasets, and the experimental results show that the proposed method is effective compared with the baseline methods.

The rest of this paper are organized as follows. Section 2 introduces the proposed method in detail. Section 3 presents the experiments and the result analysis. Section 4 concludes the paper and discusses the future work.
